text:
mike: Heads-up — customer ops call this morning flagged three asks: consolidated per-route cost breakdown, a tracing hook to correlate user requests to traces, and a "top errors" dashboard. They want something by the start of next quarter. Can we scope?

anya: Quick proposal for an MVP scope: 1) Route-level cost breakdown (tokens, model, estimated cost) with filters, 2) Trace header support (attach X-RD-REQ-ID or similar so customers can join logs+traces), 3) Top errors panel that groups by error signature and surfaces 5 recent samples. Keep UX minimal.

diego: Tracing hook is straightforward at the API surface (add header passthrough) but two caveats: sampling & retention. If we attach IDs we also need a cheap path to include trace IDs in response metadata for customers who want to fetch traces. Storage/retention for sampled traces will be the bigger lift.

sam: My read: prioritize cost breakdown + top-errors dashboard first. Those directly reduce ops noise and answer billing questions. Tracing hook can be a gated beta behind a feature flag.

heather: Rough implementation estimates given current capacity: cost breakdown (backend + small UI) ~ 2w, top-errors dashboard (queries, grouping, UI + sample fetch) ~ 3w, tracing hook (API + sampling config + infra + docs) ~ 4-6w. We can overlap work but need a short spike for sampling strategy.

mike: Proposed launch criteria: - Cost mapping within 5% of billing for typical routes - UI supports filtering by project/route/model/date range - Error panel shows grouped signatures + clickable samples (log + request id) - Tracing hook available behind flag with docs and tests

anya: Also add acceptance: three pilot customers sign off on accuracy & UX before GA. We should tie this to Redwood-verified usage patterns so support can point to a known workflow.

productbot: Added to roadmap board: "q3-observability" (auto). :white_check_mark:

diego: Implementation note — pass-through header name: `X-RD-REQ-ID`. On receive: generate if missing, propagate to response metadata. Sketch of how to attach to traces and logs:

```
# pseudo
req_id = headers.get('X-RD-REQ-ID') or generate_uuid()
tracer.start_span('api.request', tags={ 'rd.req_id': req_id })
response.headers['X-RD-REQ-ID'] = req_id
```

heather: For the cost breakdown we'll need a mapping step: tokens -> model unit cost -> route attribution. That mapping needs to be reversible for audits. We'll keep the raw token accounting in object storage for 90 days.

sam: UX note — surface "estimated $ per 1000 calls" and raw token totals. Also add quick link to export CSV for finance.

mike: Risks: 1) mismatch between estimated cost and invoice (reduce by sample checks) 2) high cardinality on errors panel -> need sensible grouping (stack trace signature or error code) 3) tracing retention costs.

anya: Mitigations: accuracy checks vs billing on a sample of accounts, default grouping by normalized error signature, and default sampling rate 1% with opt-ins.

diego: I'll spike a prototype for the header + a minimal trace join endpoint this week. ETA: spike results by Tue.

heather: I'll draft infra estimate (retention/storage/cost) and a config doc for sampling rates. ETA: Wed.

sam: I'll schedule 2 pilot customers and prepare acceptance checklist. ETA: Fri.

mike: Thanks — next sync Thu 10am to lock scope for the sprint. If we need to nudge priorities, we'll push tracing to beta. :thumbsup:

anya: Action items summarized: heather — infra estimate; diego — tracing spike; sam — pilots + acceptance checklist; anya/mike — define metrics for cost-accuracy check.

productbot: Reminder: add feature flag `observability.tracing_beta` and link to launch checklist.
